dataset.title: QR Permanence & Free Digital Business Card Transparency Index 2026
dataset.author: Rafaël Saive
dataset.disclosure: The author is the founder of GetQRcard. GetQRcard.com and MaCarteQR.fr are services of Le Chemin Numérique ASBL, based in Liège, Belgium.
dataset.method: First-party documentation audit. The GetQRcard analytics-retention and IP-hashing correction in version 1.0.1 is based on a maintainer code review. No long-term uptime testing was performed.

services.explicit_permanence_claim: permanent QR code and card advertised free for life
services.wallet_support_in_free_access: not currently counted; announced as in development for 2026-09-15
services.free_access_limits: one card; day-by-day scan chart limited to the most recent 30 days; totals and breakdowns by device and country shown from the beginning; no ads
services.scan_event_retention: no automatic deletion period in the reviewed implementation, under either plan

scan_analytics_display.free_plan: totals, devices, and countries from the beginning; day-by-day chart for the most recent 30 days
scan_analytics_display.annual_plan: totals, devices, and countries from the beginning; day-by-day chart for the most recent 90 days

services.scan_ip_handling: IP addresses are not retained in plain text; they are hashed with a salt that rotates daily, preventing cross-day linkage of the same fingerprint by the service
services.implementation_evidence: Maintainer code review of scan retention behavior and ScanTracker::hashIp(), documented 2026-08-08; the source code was not part of the public repository at release time
